items.briefing:
A new MinterEllison report reveals that 71% of Australian organisations experienced a cyber incident in the past year, with AI increasingly being used by attackers to make threats more frequent and sophisticated. This is a timely reminder that no organisation — including registered training organisations — is too small to be targeted. Separately, Experian research highlights that many Australian businesses are not yet ready to handle AI-driven data processes safely, pointing to a broader gap in digital preparedness across industries.

Review your organisation's incident response plan and make sure staff know who to contact if they suspect a cyber incident — having a clear process in place before something goes wrong makes a significant difference.

featured.title: Cyber incidents hit 71% of Australian organisations as AI reshapes the threat landscape, MinterEllison report
featured.quote: Record 71% of Australian organisations hit by cyber incidents as AI transforms threat landscape.
